title: Sea Stars Bacterial Sampling Protocol
author: Andrew Loudon
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.f7abrie

steps.title: Prepare Sampling Site
steps.instruction: Rinse the sampling location of the star with sterile seawater to remove transient microbes.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the sampling site for healthy individuals is approximately 15 by 10 cm.

steps.title: Perform Bacterial Swabbing
steps.instruction: Apply a clean sterile swab to the rinsed sample location using moderate pressure.

substeps.instruction: Pull the swab back and forth across the sample location.

steps.title: Store Samples
steps.instruction: Place the swab into a labeled sterile screw cap tube.

substeps.instruction: Keep the tube on ice until it can be frozen at -80°C.

steps.title: Extract DNA
steps.instruction: Perform DNA extraction on the swabs using a MoBio PowerSoil Kit.
